developmentNotes: An initial TypeScript fixture attempted to execute extensionless TypeScript imports directly in Node; it was stopped and corrected to compile before running tests. No successful case was claimed for that aborted run.

The first complete development run passed 8/9. The generated property test destructured a nonexistent Node assert export and native repair returned malformed JSON. A fixed Node core export lint rule, explicit guidance and a bounded JSON retry were added, then the complete nine-case run passed.
Development runs represent intermediate implementations and settings. They are not aggregated into a final-code pass-rate claim. The final multi-file feature still needed one semantic repair round.
